text:
```yaml
name: Stale Issues and PRs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch: {} # Allows manual triggering

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Run stale action
      uses: actions/stale@v10
      with:
        repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        stale-issue-message: "This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs within the next 7 days."
        stale-pr-message: "This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs within the next 7 days."
        close-issue-message: "This issue has been closed because it has not had recent activity for over 7 days."
        close-pr-message: "This pull request has been closed because it has not had recent activity for over 7 days."
        days-before-stale: 14
        days-before-issue-stale: 14
        days-before-pr-stale: 14
        days-before-close: 21
        days-before-issue-close: 21
        days-before-pr-close: 21
        stale-issue-label: "stale"
        close-issue-label: "closed"
        exempt-issue-labels: "important,urgent"
        close-issue-reason: "inactive"
```
